notes_for_editor: Thin record: no build date, builder, design, staffing or fire history in any source read. Two search rounds turned up only the directory and unrelated Isanti County courthouse pages. A guessed firelookout.org detail URL returned 404. The Commons photo and Wikidata image are already in data/photos_manifest.json, so no photos entry was added. Next checks if wanted: Isanti County Historical Society, City of Cambridge, Minnesota newspaper archives for the 1930s.
